message.text: I need to find every distinct server-side enforcement site for memo visibility and list the corresponding files.

I am identifying distinct server surfaces where memo visibility is enforced.

Found at least five enforcement sites so far. API access checks in `memo_service.go` cover `GetMemo` and `ListMemoComments`. Query-level filtering exists in `ListMemos` within `memo_service.go`. Attachment permissions are checked in `fileserver.go` and `attachment_service.go`. `memo_attachment_service` also enforces visibility on `ListMemoAttachments`.

Additional enforcement sites include `reaction_service`, `rss.go`, `frontend.go`, `memo_relation_service`, `user_service_stats`, `memo_service_comments`, `sse_hub.go`, and `memo_share`. Notifications and emails use `canViewerAccessMemo` to gate access.

I am refining my approach to distinguish true server surfaces from duplicate helpers. I will read additional files to ensure the final list captures only distinct enforcement locations.

Expanding the search to additional server surfaces beyond the initial set. New targets include RSS, frontend, reaction_service, attachment services, relation services, share services, comments, SSE hub, stats, notifications, and share-link memo access.
Checking memo_share_service and the ListMemos versus GetMemo share paths for additional memo visibility enforcement sites.
Checking whether GetMemoByShare bypasses memo visibility checks.

I am identifying distinct server-side functions that enforce memo visibility.

`checkMemoReadAccess` in `memo_service.go` enforces read access for GetMemo and ListMemoComments. `ListMemos` in `memo_service.go` filters visibility directly. `checkAttachmentAccess` in `attachment_service.go` checks attachment permissions. `checkAttachmentPermission` in `fileserver/fileserver.go` validates file access.

`ListMemoAttachments` in `memo_attachment_service.go` validates access inline. `ListMemoReactions` and `UpsertReaction` in `reaction_service.go` enforce visibility. `ListMemoRelations` in `memo_relation_service.go` applies a memo filter. `ListMemoComments` and `CreateMemoComment` in `memo_service_comments.go` use `checkMemoReadAccess`. RSS in `rss.go` exposes only public memos. The frontend sitemap in `frontend.go` restricts visibility. SSE `canReceive` in `sse_hub.go` gates events. `canViewerAccessMemo` in `user_service_notifications.go` and `notification/email.go` validates viewer access.

`user_service_stats.go` also filters visibility.

`user_service_stats.go` lines 84–90 and 218–220 filter visibility. `GetMemoByShare` intentionally bypasses standard visibility checks via share tokens. `memo_mention_helpers` governs notification recipients rather than direct memo viewing.
